a1_unrestricted_product_label_chain.principal_block_lemma: Entries incident to nodes outside a principal submatrix do not change that submatrix or its inertia. Hence an outside dotted or Lanner component cannot mediate away two negative directions already present in the selected block.
a1_unrestricted_product_label_chain.scope_upgrade: the selected theorem is selected-nerve-only; the new a=1 census proves that every surviving a=1 completion is in this exact S9 orbit, while the re-audited fixed principal block makes outside entries irrelevant by interlacing

claim: Every incidence completion of H9/14 graph shadow record 42 compatible with the compact Coxeter missing-face reductions, Dehn--Sommerville schedules, strict local inequalities, and the facet/blocker conditions fails the unrestricted compact Coxeter label tests. Hence the whole record-42 shadow is impossible in the compact case.
nonclaims: No ideal-vertex or parabolic cusp census is performed.
No finite-volume noncompact chamber is excluded.
No graph shadow other than record 42 is addressed here.
No arbitrary ordinary completion with a minimal nonface above the compact Coxeter Lanner bound is classified.
